services.desc: Growing up on the beaches of Brunswick County, Captain Tim Disano has always been drawn to the water. Tim is eager to guide our clients along the waters that he's spent years exploring. Fully licensed by the United States Coast Guard, Tim is as serious about safety as he is about catching fish. Capt. Tim specializes in light tackle and fly fishing inshore for redfish, black drum, speckled sea trout, and flounder. "To be able to share my passion for fishing and the outdoors with new friends is a dream come true."-Capt. (Melbourne, Palm Bay, Merritt Island, Vero Beach, Grant and Sebastian) I grew up fishing here, and know the flats like the back of my hand.
